# Al Rahal Auto Maintenance

> Independent Range Rover and Land Rover specialist garage in Sharjah, UAE (Arabic name: الرحال لصيانة السيارات). More than 25 years of Land Rover experience, dealer-level Land Rover diagnostics (Pathfinder and SDD), in-house engine, gearbox and air suspension repair, genuine parts, a written warranty on every repair, and a fixed price confirmed on WhatsApp before work starts.

## Key facts
- Address: Jabel Tarek Street, opposite Sharjah Cricket Stadium, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates
- WhatsApp / mobile: 055 747 9292 (+971557479292)
- Workshop telephone: 06 558 3559
- Email: alrahal8881@gmail.com

- Speciality: Range Rover (Vogue), Range Rover Sport, Range Rover Velar, Range Rover Evoque, Land Rover Defender, Land Rover Discovery
- Branch 1 (same address): German, European, American, luxury and Japanese cars
- Booking: WhatsApp booking form on every page; collection and delivery across Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman
- Website: https://www.alrahalauto.ae/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alrahalauto.ae/

## Services
- [Engine Repair & Rebuild](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/range-rover-engine-repair/): Diagnosis, repair and full rebuilds for Range Rover petrol and diesel engines, including timing chains, head gaskets and low-compression faults.
- [Gearbox & Transmission](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/range-rover-gearbox-repair/): ZF 8-speed automatic diagnostics, valve body repair, mechatronic units, fluid services and full transmission rebuilds.
- [Air Suspension Repair](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/air-suspension-repair/): Compressors, air struts, valve blocks, height sensors and leak tracing for every air-sprung Range Rover and Land Rover.
- [Brake Service & Repair](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/brake-service/): Pads, discs, calipers, electronic parking brakes and brake fluid services with genuine and Brembo components.
- [Periodic Service & Oil Change](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/periodic-service/): Manufacturer-schedule servicing with genuine filters, Castrol Edge Professional oils and a digital service book stamp.
- [Computer Diagnostics](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/diagnostics/): Dealer-level diagnostic equipment for every Land Rover module, from engine and gearbox to infotainment and body control.
- [Air Conditioning Service](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/ac-repair/): Compressor, condenser, evaporator and climate control repairs to keep every seat ice cold in 50°C summers.
- [Electrical & Wiring Repair](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/electrical-repair/): Parasitic drain tracing, harness repairs, module coding and battery system faults solved at the root.
- [Cooling System & Overheating](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/cooling-system-repair/): Radiators, water pumps, thermostats, coolant pipes and head gasket checks for engines that must survive Gulf heat.
- [Turbocharger Repair](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/turbo-repair/): Turbo diagnosis, actuator repair, reconditioned and new turbochargers for TDV6, SDV6 and Ingenium engines.
- [Steering & Rack Repair](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/steering-repair/): Electric and hydraulic steering rack repair, column modules, tie rods and four-wheel alignment.
- [Wheel Alignment & Tyres](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/wheel-alignment-tyres/): Laser four-wheel alignment, premium tyre supply, balancing, TPMS sensors and run-flat replacement.
- [Battery Replacement](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/battery-replacement/): AGM main and auxiliary batteries, correct coding and registration, and charging system checks.
- [Transfer Case & Differentials](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/transfer-case-differential/): Transfer box, front and rear differential, locking diff and driveline vibration repairs for permanent four-wheel drive.
- [Exhaust & DPF Cleaning](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/exhaust-dpf-repair/): DPF regeneration and cleaning, EGR valve service, AdBlue system repair and exhaust replacement.
- [Infotainment & Electronics](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/infotainment-repair/): Pivi Pro and InControl Touch repairs, screen replacement, camera systems, Meridian audio and software updates.
- [Pre-Purchase Inspection](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/pre-purchase-inspection/): A 150-point inspection with full diagnostic scan, history check and written report before you buy a used Range Rover.
- [Timing Chain Replacement](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/timing-chain-replacement/): Timing chain, guide and tensioner replacement for TDV6, SDV6, 5.0 V8 and Ingenium engines before failure occurs.
- [Engine & Gearbox Mounts](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/engine-mount-replacement/): Hydraulic engine mount and gearbox mount replacement to remove vibration and clunks.
- [Oil Leak Repair](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/oil-leak-repair/): Precise leak tracing and repair of sumps, rocker covers, rear main seals, oil coolers and timing covers.
- [Fuel System & Injectors](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/fuel-system-repair/): High-pressure fuel pump, injector testing and replacement, fuel filter and low-pressure system repairs.
- [Body Repair & Paint](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/body-repair-paint/): Aluminium body repair, paintless dent removal and colour-matched refinishing in a dust-controlled booth.
- [Detailing & Ceramic Coating](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/detailing-ceramic-coating/): Paint correction, ceramic coating, interior leather restoration and paint protection film.
- [Off-Road Preparation](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/services/off-road-preparation/): Desert and overland preparation: underbody protection, recovery points, tyres, cooling upgrades and Terrain Response checks.

- [Range Rover Sport](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/models/range-rover-sport/): 2005 – present; engines covered: 3.0 TDV6/SDV6, 5.0 V8 Supercharged, 3.0 Ingenium P400, SVR 5.0
- [Range Rover Velar](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/models/range-rover-velar/): 2017 – present; engines covered: 2.0 Ingenium P250/P300 petrol, 2.0 D180/D240 diesel, 3.0 P400 MHEV
- [Range Rover Evoque](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/models/range-rover-evoque/): 2011 – present; engines covered: 2.0 Si4 petrol, 2.2 SD4 diesel, 2.0 Ingenium petrol and diesel, P300e PHEV

- [Evoque Owners: Your Haldex Unit Needs a Service](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/blog/evoque-haldex-service-guide/): The all-wheel-drive coupling on the Evoque has a filter and oil that most garages ignore. Here is why that leads to a very expensive repair.
- [Preparing Your Range Rover for the Gulf Summer](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/blog/summer-preparation-range-rover/): Ten things to check before the temperature passes 45 degrees, from coolant condition to the battery you did not know you had.

- [Ingenium Diesel Oil Dilution Explained](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/blog/ingenium-engine-oil-dilution-explained/): If your oil level is rising rather than falling, your Ingenium diesel is telling you something important about how it is being driven.
- [Brake Judder on the Range Rover Sport: Causes and the Right Fix](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/blog/brake-judder-range-rover-sport/): Vibration through the steering wheel when braking from speed has three possible causes. Only one of them is warped discs.
- [Terrain Response Explained: What Each Mode Actually Changes](https://www.alrahalauto.ae/blog/terrain-response-explained/): The rotary dial does far more than change a dashboard icon. Here is what happens to the throttle, gearbox, differentials and suspension in each setting.
